limitations: First full pass had 8.2% clock drift. Silent and observed column comparisons were clock-confounded in Labs. Their raw timings do not establish a regression or improvement.
The unchanged Iris cold search control varied from 87.5 to 55.0 microseconds between runs. Treat cross-run ratios as descriptive, not isolated causal estimates.
The cached cold-search allocation p50 was zero in the candidate. Do not interpret a net heap delta clamped at zero as no allocation. Query construction allocates.
Prepared column rows and entities were warmed before the timed column loop. Structural refresh cost is included in the mutation-plus-materialization cases instead.

Warm Koota spawning reuses a context, compiled schema and reserved storage. Destruction and any capacity replenishment occur outside the sample. Iris spawning starts from a new empty world and grows storage inside creation. Cold cases include Koota reservation.
The initial population-only pass recreated Koota schemas before every spawn sample. Its warm-case result is excluded and replaced by the persistent-context case.
The kernels run TypeScript source through tsx on Node 26.1.0. Bundled and browser performance can differ.
